title: The Lund Oat Drink That a Dairy Manager Spat Out
conflicts: Co-founders: the EPO (2026) says Öste and Angeliki Triantafyllou co-founded Ceba in 1994; Wikipedia says Öste and his brother Björn in 1994, but Lund University says Björn joined in 1997. The story credits Öste and Triantafyllou. The Arla tasting rests on Öste's own account and is attributed to him. Early partnerships (soup, UK drink, Danone yoghurt, ICA's Solhavre) are undated in the sources, so the story gives them as a loose sequence.
notes: Slate named only Öste; Triantafyllou (European Inventor Award 2026) is added as co-founder. Lund's 6 billion kronor 2021 turnover figure not used.
